messages:
Ava - CS: Heads up — NovoRetail usage dropped ~48% week-over-week. They told Raj they're in a short-list pilot with CloudAI for Q3. Renewal on 2026-08-01. Can we triage? :thinking_face:

Raj - AM: Saw the pilot invite. Renewal date confirmed 2026-08-01, ~$120k ARR. Need a fast win to keep them. I'll push for exec time if we can demonstrate measurable uplift in 2 weeks.

Mira - Solutions: Onboarding is actually stalled: SFTP -> Redwood ingest creds never provisioned, and they raised embedding quality issues (duplicates/freshness). Their batch jobs are paused. Quick checklist: 1) creds + access 2) schema mapping 3) quick eval prompt set. CC @Jon - SE for logs.

Jon - SE: Looking at logs now — embeddings pipeline started returning 400s for NovoRetail after 2026-03-10 03:12 UTC. Snippet:
```
Error 400: invalid input vector length
  at embeddings_service.py:224
```
Likely upstream data change (CSV shape). Suggest small re-ingest of a 1k row sample + run eval harness.

Ava - CS: Thanks — Raj can you push for a joint health-check call this week? Mira, can you draft a 2-week salvage plan (deliverables + checkpoints)?

Raj - AM: Scheduled a sync: 2026-03-12 14:00 PT with their CTO + procurement. Calendar invite sent. I'll attach the contract summary and an exec one-pager ahead of the call.

Mira - Solutions: Will send the salvage plan by EOD. Quick-win ideas: 1) revert to previous embedding variant (mu-lite) for freshness 2) enable prefix caching for top SKUs 3) attach eval harness with 300 sample prompts to show delta.

Jon - SE: Revert is trivial via config: `model_variant: mu-lite-1.3` — can roll with zero downtime. Also recommend hash-based re-batching for SKU-heavy requests to reduce spikes. I'll prep smoke tests.

Oncall Bot: Alert: embedding errors elevated for customer NovoRetail between 2026-03-10T03:12Z and 2026-03-11T06:00Z — 412 failed requests. Details: https://redwood.internal/alerts/INC-4721

Ava - CS: Capture customer feedback: their lead merch reported 'poor freshness and duplicates' on embeddings. Added to feedback doc: https://docs.redwood.com/cs/novoretail-feedback — please add repro prompts.

Raj - AM: Competitive note: CloudAI's pilot touts a "real-time SKU ranker" at aggressive pilot pricing. Our angle: predictable latency + lower token cost + SLA for their enterprise use. I'll prep a short TCO slide for the exec call.

Mira - Solutions: I'll produce a short demo notebook comparing mu-lite vs current embeddings on the SKU dedup test and share a link before the call.

Ava - CS: Plan recap: Mira sends salvage plan + demo by EOD 2026-03-11; Jon stages the mu-lite revert and runs smoke tests; Raj runs exec health-check on 2026-03-12. If usage doesn't rebound by 2026-03-20 we'll open a renewal rescue playbook and loop in CS leadership. :white_check_mark:

Raj - AM: Ack.

Jon - SE: On it, will post smoke test results in this thread when done.
